CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting
